messages:
Priya S: quick kickoff — customer Switchyard wants to migrate from DeepBridge API, POC next week. needs: prompt parity, billing mapping, SSO, and security questionnaire answers. who can own tech presales for this one?
Sam W: I can lead the POC tech side. need example calls and response deltas from their API — any sample payloads?
Maria L: tagging in product: we should outline expected deltas up front. are they using streaming responses? that usually causes the biggest parity issues.
Devon K: FYI they use chunked streaming + some custom metadata headers. I saw note in the intake doc. can we get a sample chat session?
Priya S: customer already shared a couple of logs in the intake form. uploading the link: https://redwood-confluence.local/switchyard/poc-artifacts (internal)
Ash G: for pricing questions: they bill per-token with a blended embed/gen rate. we need a mapping doc for our per-token vs their semantics and an example invoice scenario. I can run numbers if someone gives traffic profile (avg tokens/req, rps).
Sam W: sending a quick curl example we used for their adapter test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.deepbridge.example/v1/chat 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer XXX' 
 -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize sales deck"}],"stream":true}'
```
Sam W: expected differences: they append a trailing metadata chunk that our runtime strips by default. need to confirm if customer depends on that chunk.
Maria L: action: create a small prompt-parity checklist. items: tokenization differences, streaming vs non-streaming behavior, stop-sequences, metadata headers, and function-calling semantics.
Devon K: security asks: they want to know KMS/HSM options, data residency, and SOC2/ISO attestations. also need to complete their vendor security questionnaire (pdf). @sec-bot can you spike the questionnaire answers?
sec-bot: automated-scan: I parsed the questionnaire PDF and pre-filled answers for SOC2/ISO sections. link: https://vault.redwood.local/sec/switchyard-deepbridge-poc-draft.yml. please review before sending.
Priya S: great. Devon, can you own the questionnaire review? deadline EOD Thu.
Devon K: I can review. will flag anything that needs legal/signature.
Ash G: also need to lock SLA/backstop language for Dedicated vs Hosted. customer asked whether a Dedicated commit would get lower unit cost. short answer: yes, but we need to model their committed RPU. please send sample traffic.
Priya S: Action items recap: Sam -> run adapter smoke and generate response diffs by Monday. Maria -> draft prompt-parity checklist and tests. Ash -> price model scenarios, ask for tokens/rps. Devon -> review security questionnaire & confirm KMS options. Sec-bot -> export the draft answers. Ops Oncall -> can you preapprove network IPs for customer staging?
Ops Oncall: can do. need the CIDR list from the customer's network team. share here or DM.
Sam W: quick note about POC infra: we'll run their adapter in a sandbox Dedicated instance to mimic latency and streaming. might need a quantized variant for cost parity testing.
Maria L: test harness ideas: 50 sample prompts (mix of short/long), streaming and non-streaming flows, function-call traces, and a billing simulator that converts token counts to their invoice format.
Priya S: timeline: POC kickoff Mon 09:00 PT. customer demo Fri. that gives us 4 working days. keep updates here daily.
Devon K: one blocker I foresee: their SSO uses SAML with encrypted assertions. our private deployment supports that but we need a SAML metadata exchange and a test IdP. flagging now so legal/infra can prep certs.
Ash G: pricing Q: if we need to do a fallback to a cheaper model for cost spikes, what's the acceptance criteria? would product sign off on possible model quality regression?
Maria L: product + customer must agree on quality thresholds. propose we include a small set of golden prompts for regression gating. if delta > X% on key metrics, no fallback.
Priya S: good. I'll surface that in the customer kickoff and get their buy-in on the golden prompt set.
Sam W: uploading initial smoke diff results in a sec-minutes. will post highlights here.
Priya S: thanks team. ping if you need me to escalate with legal or solutions engineering. :thumbsup:
